points.description: States the answer FALSE (the statement is incorrect).
Justification: parent and child are two independent/separate processes, so the parent does not have to wait for the child to terminate before continuing.
points.partial_credit: Half if only says the parent need not wait, without saying the processes are independent.

points.description: Justification: the parent can perform any operation, including calling exec, while the child is running (exec in the parent is allowed).
points.partial_credit: Half if says parent can continue running but does not mention exec or any operation.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) need FALSE plus a correct justification: parent and child are independent processes, and the parent can call exec (or any operation) without waiting for the child. If the justification is missing or wrong, give 0 overall, as the question says no correct justification means no marks. Part marks for a vague or partly stated justification; TRUE earns nothing.
